content:
maria: quick smoke run of the new llama-7b-q4f16 bring-up across regions. edge routing split was 60/30/10 (us-east/us-west/eu-west). dropping raw p50/p99 + tokens/s and a few notes.

aj: can you paste the numbers? short table is fine.

maria: sure — paste below (all latencies are server-side generation only, excluding client RTT). kernel variants tested: flash_attn2 and fused_attn. batch=1, max_len=128, prompt_tokens ~40, gen_tokens=50, kv-warmup enabled for steady-state.

```
region  gpu   kernel        p50(ms)  p99(ms)  tokens/s
us-east  A100  fused_attn     46       210      820
us-east  H100  flash_attn2    32       150     1200
us-west  A100  fused_attn     55       240      740
us-west  H100  flash_attn2    40       170     1050
eu-west  A100  fused_attn     71       340      620
eu-west  H100  flash_attn2    58       270      900
```

maria: notes: 1) eu-west shows p99 inflation (~+120ms vs us-east) probably from cross-pop proxy + occasional kernel fallback when memory pressure hits and we OOM small kernels. 2) flash_attn2 beats fused_attn consistently on H100; A100 favors fused_attn micro-ops. 3) KV cache warmup reduces p50 by ~10-15% after steady-state.

eva: what was the traffic mix? seq lengths and concurrency? helps sizing.

maria: test config: synthetic replay from prod trace sampled 2k requests, avg tokens/request=50, concurrency target=100 qps. sequence distribution: 70% short (<64), 30% medium (64-256).

tony: quick capacity calc: requirement = 100 rps * 50 tokens = 5k tokens/s. using tokens/s above ->
- H100-us-east (1200 t/s) => ceil(5000/1200)=5 GPUs
- A100-us-east (820 t/s) => ceil(5000/820)=7 GPUs
- Suggest spread: primary capacity in us-east H100 (5), warm standby in us-west (2 H100), eu-west on-demand (1-2 H100) until we fix p99.

aj: good. any insights on routing policy change to avoid eu-west p99 spikes?

maria: yes — immediate mitigation: change edge routing policy to latency-aware for the latency-sensitive route: prefer nodes with expected p95 < 200ms. fallback to eu-west only when regional capacity < 20%. That keeps p99 stable. Also reduce eu-west split to 5% for canary.

infra-bot: deploybot: rolling canary started for route=chat-gen, split={us-east:0.85, us-west:0.10, eu-west:0.05}, tag=llama7b-q4f16-v1. infra-bot: canary window 30m.

liam: i'll run the extended 6-hour bench with 5k tokens/s target and full seq-dist. will log kernel-level traces (nvprof + perf counters) and upload. ETA 3h.

tony: also flag for quality: quantized bring-up showed small tokenization edge-case for rare unicode — eva can run eval set 1k prompts to check regression.

eva: on it — will run regen checks and compare top-1 token divergence vs float32 baseline. will post summary in ~2h.

aj: sweet. next steps: liam runs extended perf, eva runs quality eval, infra keeps canary. maria to investigate kernel fallback triggers and whether we can force flash_attn2 on H100 in eu-west. update in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:

maria: noted. starting kernel trace collection now.

liam: ack, starting bench. will notify when artifacts uploaded.

maria: thanks — if p99 remains bad after kernel fixes we should consider regional model variant (smaller kv-hosting or lower-alloc quant profile) as a temporary fallback.

aj: agreed. thanks all.
